PNDI 620.description: Examination of nutritional concerns, requirements, and metabolism from pre-conception through the aging process; analysis of cultural, environmental, psychosocial, physical, and economic factors affecting nutritional status through the life cycle; and methods for assuring adequate nutrition through dietary selection, promotion of healthy eating throughout the life cycle and nutritional assessment for each state of the life cycle.
PNDI 620.subject: PNDI
PNDI 620.title: Nutrition Through the Life Cycle

PNDI 700.description: Application of the scientific method in nutrition research and practice including research design, execution, dissemination, and translation of findings.
PNDI 700.subject: PNDI
PNDI 700.title: Applied Nutrition Research

PNDI 701.description: Nutritional needs, nutrition strategies, and nutrition-related factors affecting athletic performance in a variety of sports and performance activities.
PNDI 701.subject: PNDI
PNDI 701.title: Performance Nutrition

PNDI 705.description: Unique topics specific to the approaches within and advocacy of performance nutrition and sports dietetics.
PNDI 705.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 701.
PNDI 705.subject: PNDI
PNDI 705.title: Performance Nutrition: Approaches and Advocacy

PNDI 710.description: Application of nutrition and dietary interventions in health and disease using the principles of medical nutrition therapy and the Nutrition Care Process. Students will learn about the pathophysiology of nutrition-related diseases, nutrition assessment, diagnosis, intervention, monitoring, and evaluation to manage disease conditions, recovery, and/or improve the quality of life.
PNDI 710.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 620 or HPEB 620; B or better in PNDI 700 .
PNDI 710.subject: PNDI
PNDI 710.title: Medical Nutrition Therapy I

PNDI 711.description: Foundational supervised experience in the field of nutrition and dietetics that applies knowledge about life cycle nutrition, general nutrition and health, nutrition research, and performance nutrition in practice settings.
PNDI 711.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 620 or HPEB 620; B or better in PNDI 700; B or better in PNDI 701 .
PNDI 711.subject: PNDI
PNDI 711.title: Performance Nutrition Dietetics Supervised Experience Level 1

PNDI 712.description: Preparatory supervised experience in the field of nutrition and dietetics that applies knowledge about public health nutrition, food service, food systems, and nutrition services in practice settings.
PNDI 712.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 752 or HPEB 752; B or better in PNDI 705; B or better in PNDI 710 .
PNDI 712.subject: PNDI
PNDI 712.title: Performance Nutrition Dietetics Supervised Experience Level 2

PNDI 713.description: Supervised experience in the field of nutrition and dietetics with an emphasis on introductory nutrition therapy, nutrition counseling, and nutrition education in various practice settings.
PNDI 713.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 752 or HPEB 752; B or better in PNDI 705; B or better in PNDI 710; B or better in PNDI 730.
PNDI 713.subject: PNDI
PNDI 713.title: Performance Nutrition Dietetics Supervised Experience Level 3

PNDI 714.description: Upper-level supervised experience in the field of nutrition and dietetics with an emphasis on nutrition therapy, services, and management in therapeutic and performance settings.
PNDI 714.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 710, PNDI 730, and PNDI 770 .
PNDI 714.subject: PNDI
PNDI 714.title: Performance Nutrition Dietetics Supervised Experience Level 4

PNDI 715.description: Final supervised experience with preceptors in advanced therapeutic and managerial settings within the field of nutrition and dietetics.
PNDI 715.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 730, PNDI 740, PNDI 750, PNDI 760, and PNDI 770.
PNDI 715.subject: PNDI
PNDI 715.title: Performance Nutrition Dietetics Supervised Experience Level 5

PNDI 730.description: Educational and counseling components of nutrition interventions within nutrition care plans. Both psychological counseling and educational pedagogy will be emphasized.
PNDI 730.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 620 or HPEB 620; B or better in PNDI 700 .
PNDI 730.subject: PNDI
PNDI 730.title: Nutrition Counseling Education

PNDI 740.description: Application of nutrition and dietary interventions in illness and disease management using the principles of medical nutrition therapy and the Nutrition Care Process. Students will learn individualized nutrition care planning for patients with complex medical conditions.
PNDI 740.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 710.
PNDI 740.subject: PNDI
PNDI 740.title: Medical Nutrition Therapy II

PNDI 750.description: Intersection of performance nutrition and medical nutrition therapy in which students learn to provide performance nutrition services to performers, athletes, teams, and athletic organizations.
PNDI 750.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 701, PNDI 710, and PNDI 730.
PNDI 750.subject: PNDI
PNDI 750.title: Performance Nutrition Therapy

PNDI 752.description: A study of the relationship of human nutrition to public health and the potential for risk reduction through health education.
PNDI 752.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: C or better in HPEB 502 or equivalent.
PNDI 752.subject: PNDI
PNDI 752.title: Nutrition and Public Health

PNDI 760.description: Students will learn to apply leadership, management, and business principles to guide practice in the field of nutrition and dietetics.
PNDI 760.prerequisite_text: Prerequisites: B or better in PNDI 620 or HPEB 620; B or better in PNDI 700; B or better in PNDI 701; B or better in PNDI 752 or HPEB 752.
PNDI 760.subject: PNDI
PNDI 760.title: Leadership and Practice in Performance Nutrition and Dietetics

PNDI 770.description: The application of food systems principles and management skills to ensure safe delivery of nutritious food.
PNDI 770.subject: PNDI
PNDI 770.title: Food Systems Management

PNDI 780.description: Students will summarize the ways in which they are becoming professionally competent in the field of nutrition and dietetics.
PNDI 780.subject: PNDI
PNDI 780.title: Performance Nutrition and Dietetics Capstone
